textes.Bienvenue à l’aquarium des Trois Marées,: Welcome to the Trois Marées Aquarium, on the coast of Brittany. Tanks, residents, water readings, equipment and activities: all its data is here. You help its team: Victoire, the director, Quentin, the head aquarist, Sacha, the vet, Ulysse, the technician, and Romane, who runs the school activities. Explore the database to solve the missions.
textes.Une ligne par aquariologiste, les soigne: One row per aquarist, the keepers who look after the tanks and their residents: first name, last name, specialty and hire date. An aquarist can be in charge of several tanks, or none.
textes.Une ligne par bassin, sur le parcours de: One row per tank, on the visitor route or backstage: its name, its zone, its water type, its volume, its temperature limits and the aquarist in charge. A tank can have no residents.
textes.Une ligne par groupe d’animaux d’une mêm: One row per group of animals of the same species in a tank, from a single animal to a whole school: its species, its category, its tank, its headcount, its arrival date and its origin. A species can live in several tanks.
textes.Une ligne par relevé de l’eau d’un bassi: One row per water reading of a tank, from June 23 to July 4, 2025: its date, its time, the temperature, the pH, the salinity, the nitrates and the aquarist who took it. A tank can have several readings on the same day, or none.
textes.Une ligne par équipement (pompe, filtre,: One row per piece of equipment (pump, filter, heater…): its type, its tank, its install date and its current status. Some equipment serves the whole aquarium and isn’t linked to any tank.
textes.Une ligne par intervention sur un équipe: One row per intervention on a piece of equipment (a breakdown repair, maintenance or a part replacement): its dates, its contractor, its cost and its description. A piece of equipment can have several, or none.
textes.Une ligne par animation proposée aux cla: One row per activity offered to school classes: its name, its tank, its duration, the maximum number of students per session and the price per student. An activity can have no bookings.
textes.Une ligne par réservation d’une animatio: One row per booking of an activity by a class: its school, its city, its level, its date, its time, its numbers of students and chaperones, and its status. They cover the 2024-2025 school year and the start of the fall 2025 term.
textes.Spécialité : « Eau douce », « Faune atla: Specialty: “Freshwater”, “Atlantic wildlife”, “Jellies”, “Generalist”, “Coral reefs” or “Sharks and rays”.
textes.Date d’embauche à l’aquarium, au format: Date the aquarist was hired, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Nom du bassin (ex. « Grand Récif », « Ru: Name of the tank (e.g. “Great Reef”, “Salmon Stream”).
textes.Espace où se trouve le bassin : « Galeri: Area where the tank is: “Tropical Gallery”, “Atlantic Gallery”, “Freshwater Gallery” or “Backstage”, off the visitor route, where the quarantine tanks are.
textes.Type d’eau : « Eau de mer », « Eau douce: Water type: “Seawater”, “Freshwater” or “Brackish water”, a mix of freshwater and seawater.
Volume of water in the tank, in liters.
textes.Température minimale de l’eau, en degrés: Minimum water temperature, in degrees Celsius: below it, the water is too cold for the tank’s residents.
textes.Température maximale de l’eau, en degrés: Maximum water temperature, in degrees Celsius: above it, the water is too warm for the tank’s residents.
The aquarist in charge of the tank.
textes.Identifiant unique du groupe de pensionn: Unique ID of the group of residents.
textes.Nom courant de l’espèce, en français (ex: Common name of the species (e.g. “Clownfish”, “Small-spotted catshark”).
textes.Catégorie d’animaux : « Poisson », « Req: Animal category: “Fish”, “Shark”, “Ray”, “Jellyfish”, “Turtle” or “Invertebrate” (crabs, shrimp, sea urchins…).
The tank where the group lives.
textes.Nombre d’animaux du groupe : 1 pour un a: Number of animals in the group: 1 for a single animal.
textes.Date d’arrivée du groupe à l’aquarium, o: Date the group arrived at the aquarium, or was born for a group born here, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Origine du groupe : « Naissance » (né à: Origin of the group: “Born here” (born at the aquarium), “Breeder” (bought from a breeder), “Exchange” (came from another aquarium), “Wild-caught” (taken from the wild, at sea or in a river, with a permit) or “Rescue” (an injured or stranded animal taken in by the aquarium).
The tank whose water was measured.
Date of the reading, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Heure du relevé, au format HH:MM (ex. «: Time of the reading, in HH:MM format (e.g. “08:30”).
textes.pH de l’eau : sous 7, elle est acide ; a: Water pH: below 7, it’s acidic; above 7, it’s basic.
textes.Salinité de l’eau, en grammes de sel par: Water salinity, in grams of salt per liter; empty (NULL) in freshwater, where it isn’t measured.
textes.Teneur en nitrates, en milligrammes par: Nitrate level, in milligrams per liter; empty (NULL) when the measurement couldn’t be taken.
The aquarist who took the reading.
textes.Type d’équipement : « Chauffage », « Écl: Equipment type: “Heater”, “Lighting”, “Protein skimmer” (it removes waste from seawater), “Filter”, “Generator”, “Reverse osmosis unit” (it makes pure water), “Pump”, “Chiller” or “UV sterilizer”.
textes.Le bassin équipé ; vide (NULL) pour un é: The tank it equips; empty (NULL) for equipment shared by the whole aquarium.
textes.Date d’installation de l’équipement, au: Date the equipment was installed, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.État actuel : « En service », « En panne: Current status: “In service”, “Broken down” or “Under maintenance” (maintenance is in progress).
textes.Type d’intervention : « Panne » (la répa: Intervention type: “Breakdown” (a breakdown repair), “Maintenance” (a scheduled service) or “Replacement” (a part swapped).
textes.Date du début de l’intervention, au form: Start date of the intervention, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Date de la fin de l’intervention (AAAA-M: End date of the intervention (YYYY-MM-DD); empty (NULL) if it’s still in progress.
textes.L’entreprise extérieure qui est interven: The outside company that did the work; empty (NULL) when the aquarium’s technical team handled it.
textes.Coût de l’intervention, en euros, pièces: Cost of the intervention, in euros, parts and labor; for an intervention in progress, the amount in the quote.
textes.Ce qui a été constaté ou fait, en quelqu: What was found or done, in a few words (e.g. “Burnt-out motor”).
textes.Le bassin devant lequel se déroule l’ani: The tank where the activity takes place; empty (NULL) for an activity that doesn’t happen in front of a tank.
Duration of the activity, in minutes.
Maximum number of students per session.
textes.Prix par élève, en euros ; les accompagn: Price per student, in euros; chaperones don’t pay.
textes.Nom de l’école, du collège ou du lycée (: Name of the school (e.g. “École des Goélands”).
textes.Niveau de la classe : « Maternelle », «: Level of the class: “Preschool”, “Elementary”, “Middle school” or “High school”.
textes.Date de l’animation réservée, au format: Date of the booked activity, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
textes.Heure de début de l’animation, au format: Start time of the activity, in HH:MM format (e.g. “10:00”).
Number of students in the class.
textes.Nombre d’adultes qui accompagnent la cla: Number of adults who come with the class.
textes.Statut de la réservation : « Confirmée »: Booking status: “Confirmed”, “Pending” (the class hasn’t confirmed yet) or “Cancelled”.
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Its tanks hold seawater, freshwater or brackish water, a mix of the two. Each one has its volume, and a minimum and maximum temperature the water must stay between. Quentin, the head aquarist, leads the tank keepers. Backstage, he posts a sheet for the freshwater tanks, with the volume and temperature limits of each one.
textes.sa température minimale, en degrés Celsi: its minimum temperature, in degrees Celsius
textes.sa température maximale, en degrés Celsi: its maximum temperature, in degrees Celsius
textes.les bassins dont le type d’eau est « Eau: the tanks whose water type is “Freshwater”
textes.Une seule condition sur le type d’eau, c: A single condition on the water type, compared exactly with the text “Freshwater”. Then sort from the largest volume to the smallest.
textes.Quels équipements ne sont rattachés à au: Which equipment isn’t linked to any tank?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Each piece of equipment (pump, filter or heater) belongs to a tank. Some, though, serve the whole aquarium, like the pump that draws seawater from the bay: they aren’t linked to any tank, and the cell stays empty. Ulysse, the maintenance technician, is planning the upkeep of this shared equipment, with its type, its install date and its current status.
textes.les équipements dont le bassin est vide: the equipment whose tank is empty (NULL)
textes.par date d’installation, puis par identi: by install date, then by ID
textes.Un équipement commun se reconnaît à sa c: Shared equipment is the equipment whose tank cell is empty. You can’t compare an empty cell with an equals sign: there’s a separate way to ask whether a cell is empty.
textes.Quel est le volume des petits bassins, e: What is the volume of the small tanks, in cubic meters?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Its tanks range from a few thousand liters to nearly a million liters for the largest. Sacha, the vet, has to treat the small tanks for a parasite. The medicine is dosed per cubic meter of water, and a cubic meter holds 1,000 liters. He wants the volume, in cubic meters, of each tank under 10,000 liters.
textes.son volume en mètres cubes : le volume e: its volume in cubic meters: the volume in liters divided by 1,000, rounded to one decimal place
textes.Le volume est un nombre entier : divisé: The volume is a whole number: divided by 1000, it loses its decimals (3 instead of 3.2); divide it by 1000.0.
textes.Garde les volumes sous 10 000 litres, pu: Keep the volumes under 10,000 liters, then calculate the volume in cubic meters in the displayed columns. Divide by a decimal number, otherwise the division loses its decimals, then round.
textes.Quelles espèces ont été prélevées dans l: Which species were taken from the wild?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Its residents live in groups of a single species, and each group has an origin: a breeder, born at the aquarium, an exchange, a rescue, or caught in the wild, at sea or in a river. The same species can live in several tanks. Sacha, the vet, keeps the register of wild-caught animals, which the aquarium’s collection permit depends on. To update it, he needs the list of these species.
textes.le nom de l’espèce (une ligne par espèce: the name of the species (one row per species, no duplicates)
textes.Une même espèce peut avoir été prélevée: The same species may have been caught for several tanks: it only appears once.
textes.Une seule condition sur la provenance, c: A single condition on the origin, compared exactly with the text “Wild-caught”. A species caught for several tanks would come back several times: ask to show each row only once.
textes.Combien de requins vivent à l’aquarium ?: How many sharks live at the aquarium?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Its residents live in groups of a single species, from a single animal to a whole school, and each group has its headcount, its number of animals. At the shark feeding, students always ask how many sharks live at the aquarium. Romane, who runs the school activities, wants to give them the exact number, across all tanks, on the sheet handed to teachers.
textes.le nombre total de requins : la somme de: the total number of sharks: the sum of the headcounts of the groups in the “Shark” category
textes.les pensionnaires de la catégorie « Requ: the residents in the “Shark” category, in every tank
textes.Les petites roussettes sont des requins: Small-spotted catsharks are sharks: they count too.
textes.Chaque ligne est un groupe de plusieurs: Each row is a group of several animals: add up their headcounts rather than counting the rows. Keep only the “Shark” category.
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Classes, from preschool to high school, book activities there; each booking is confirmed, pending or cancelled. Romane, who runs the school activities, is sending a satisfaction survey to the classes that came in May 2025. She needs every booking that month that wasn’t cancelled, with the activity attended, the day, the time and the number of students.
textes.les réservations dont la date tombe en m: the bookings whose date falls in May 2025, from May 1 to 31 inclusive
textes.par date, puis par heure, puis par nombr: by date, then by time, then by number of students, largest first
textes.Relie chaque réservation à son animation: Link each booking to its activity to show its name. Two conditions true at the same time: the date falls in May 2025, which a date function can check, and the status isn’t “Cancelled”.
textes.Quels bassins ont un nom de plus de 20 c: Which tanks have a name longer than 20 characters?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Its tanks, on the visitor route or backstage, each have a name, sometimes a long one. Ulysse, the maintenance technician, is putting a small screen in front of each tank, but its banner only shows 20 characters. He’s looking for the tank names that are too long, with their number of characters, so they can be shortened.
textes.son nombre de caractères, espaces et tir: its number of characters, spaces and hyphens included
textes.les bassins dont le nom compte plus de 2: the tanks whose name has more than 20 characters (20 excluded)
textes.par nombre de caractères, du plus grand: by number of characters, largest first
textes.Une fonction donne le nombre de caractèr: A function gives the number of characters in a text, spaces included. Use it twice: to keep the names longer than 20 characters, and to show their length.
textes.Quels sont les 3 groupes de pensionnaire: What are the 3 largest groups of residents?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Its residents live in groups of a single species, from a single animal to a whole school. Victoire, the director, is preparing the new brochure. On the front page, she wants to show the 3 groups of residents with the most animals, with the name of the tank where visitors can see them.
textes.l’effectif du groupe : son nombre d’anim: the headcount of the group: its number of animals
textes.seulement les 3 premières lignes de ce t: only the first 3 rows of this sort
textes.Relie chaque groupe à son bassin pour en: Link each group to its tank to show its name. Sort from the largest headcount to the smallest, then keep the first 3 rows.
textes.Quels relevés dépassent 25 mg/L de nitra: Which readings are above 25 mg/L of nitrates?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Its aquarists, the tank keepers, regularly test the water of each tank (temperature, pH, salinity and nitrates). Nitrates are animal waste that builds up in the water, and they aren’t always measured. Quentin, the head aquarist, has part of the water changed as soon as nitrates go above 25 milligrams per liter. He reviews each reading concerned, from the highest to the lowest, to check that the water was changed.
textes.sa teneur en nitrates, en milligrammes p: its nitrate level, in milligrams per liter
textes.les relevés dont la teneur en nitrates d: the readings whose nitrate level is above 25 mg/L (25 excluded)
textes.par teneur en nitrates, de la plus forte: by nitrate level, highest first, then by date, then by time
textes.Un relevé sans mesure de nitrates (case: A reading without a nitrate measurement (empty cell) doesn’t count.
textes.Relie chaque relevé à son bassin pour en: Link each reading to its tank to show its name, then compare the nitrates with 25, strictly above. An empty measurement fails every comparison: it stays out on its own.
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Each intervention on a piece of equipment (a breakdown, maintenance or a part replacement) is described in a few words, with its cost. Victoire, the director, is renewing the water damage insurance. The insurer asks her for the interventions linked to a leak: she wants their date, the equipment involved, their cost and what was found.
textes.la date de début de l’intervention: the start date of the intervention
textes.le type de l’équipement concerné: the type of the equipment involved
textes.le coût de l’intervention, en euros: the cost of the intervention, in euros
textes.les interventions dont la description co: the interventions whose description contains the word “leak”, with or without a capital letter
textes.Relie chaque intervention à son équipeme: Link each intervention to its equipment to find its type. To look for a word anywhere in the description, compare it with a pattern where a symbol stands for any sequence of characters.
textes.Combien d’animaux vivent dans chaque bas: How many animals live in each tank?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Each tank holds groups of residents of a single species, each with its number of animals, but a tank can sometimes be empty. Victoire, the director, is preparing the annual report for the town hall. For each tank, even one that’s empty right now, she wants the number of groups of residents and the total number of animals.
textes.son nombre de groupes de pensionnaires,: its number of groups of residents, 0 if it has none
textes.son nombre total d’animaux : la somme de: its total number of animals: the sum of the headcounts of its groups, 0 if it has none
textes.tous les bassins, y compris ceux qui n’o: every tank, including those with no residents
textes.par nombre total d’animaux, du plus gran: by total number of animals, largest first, then by tank name
textes.Pars de tous les bassins, même vides. Co: Start from every tank, even empty ones. Count their groups and add up their headcounts: for an empty tank, the sum gives an empty cell, which a function can replace with 0.
textes.Quels relevés sortent des limites de tem: Which readings are outside their tank’s temperature limits?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Each tank has a minimum and a maximum temperature to respect, and the heatwave at the end of June 2025 put the water to the test. Quentin, the head aquarist, is reviewing it. He wants every reading where the water was too cold or too warm for its tank, and in which direction it went outside the limits; a temperature equal to a limit is still within bounds.
textes.la température relevée, en degrés Celsiu: the temperature measured, in degrees Celsius
textes.le sens de l’écart : « Trop froid » sous: the direction of the gap: “Too cold” below the tank’s minimum temperature, “Too hot” above its maximum temperature
textes.seulement les relevés dont la températur: only the readings whose temperature is strictly below the minimum or strictly above the maximum of their tank
textes.Une température égale à la minimale ou à: A temperature equal to the minimum or the maximum is still within the limits.
textes.Relie chaque relevé à son bassin pour co: Link each reading to its tank to compare the temperature with both of its limits: either condition is enough. Then write the direction of the gap depending on the limit crossed.
textes.Quelles espèces vivent dans plusieurs ba: Which species live in several tanks?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. The same species can live in several tanks, in separate groups, including the quarantine tanks backstage. When a disease hits a species, Sacha, the vet, has to watch every tank where it lives. So he’s finding the species present in at least 2 different tanks, with their total number of animals.
textes.son nombre total d’animaux : la somme de: its total number of animals: the sum of the headcounts of its groups, across all tanks
textes.seulement les espèces présentes dans au: only the species present in at least 2 different tanks
textes.par nombre de bassins, du plus grand au: by number of tanks, largest first, then by species name
textes.Les bassins de quarantaine, dans les cou: The quarantine tanks, backstage, count too.
textes.Forme un groupe par espèce. Compte ses b: Make one group per species. Count its different tanks, without duplicates, and add up its headcounts; the condition on the number of tanks applies once the grouping is done.
textes.De combien la température de chaque bass: How much did the temperature of each tank vary?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Each water reading records the tank’s temperature, and fish don’t cope well with changes in it. Quentin, the head aquarist, wants to spot the tanks that need better regulation. For each one, he wants the lowest and highest temperatures actually measured, and the gap between them.
textes.sa température la plus basse relevée, en: its lowest measured temperature, in degrees Celsius
textes.sa température la plus haute relevée, en: its highest measured temperature, in degrees Celsius
textes.l’amplitude : la plus haute moins la plu: the range: the highest minus the lowest, rounded to one decimal place
textes.seulement les bassins qui ont au moins u: only the tanks with at least one reading
textes.Ce sont les températures des relevés, pa: These are the temperatures from the readings, not the limits set for the tank.
textes.Relie les relevés à leur bassin et forme: Link the readings to their tank and make one group per tank. Two functions give the smallest and largest value in a group; their difference gives the gap.
textes.Combien de jours dure une panne, selon l: How many days does a breakdown last, by equipment type?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Each intervention on a piece of equipment is a breakdown, maintenance or a part replacement, with a start date and, once finished, an end date. Ulysse, the maintenance technician, is choosing which spare parts to keep in stock. For each equipment type, he compares the number of breakdowns repaired and the average number of days the repair took.
textes.leur durée moyenne, en jours, arrondie à: their average duration, in days, rounded to one decimal place
textes.seulement les interventions de type « Pa: only the interventions of type “Breakdown” that are finished, meaning they have an end date
textes.seulement les types d’équipement qui ont: only the equipment types with at least one finished breakdown
textes.par durée moyenne, de la plus longue à l: by average duration, longest first, then by number of breakdowns, largest first
textes.La durée d’une panne est sa date de fin: The duration of a breakdown is its end date minus its start date, in days: a breakdown repaired the same day lasts 0 days.
textes.Garde les pannes terminées, celles qui o: Keep the finished breakdowns, the ones with an end date. Since the dates are text, a function has to turn them into numbers of days to calculate the duration. Then take the average per equipment type.
textes.Combien les animations scolaires rapport: How much do the school activities bring in each month?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Each activity offered to classes has its price per student, from €3.50 to €7; chaperones don’t pay. Classes book it for a specific date, and the booking is confirmed, pending or cancelled. Romane, who runs the school activities, is preparing her budget. Month by month, she wants the number of confirmed bookings, past or upcoming, their number of students and what they bring in.
textes.le mois de l’animation, au format AAAA-M: the month of the activity, in YYYY-MM format, for example “2024-09” (one row per month)
textes.leur recette, en euros : pour chaque rés: their revenue, in euros: for each booking, its number of students multiplied by the activity’s price per student, then the sum over the month
textes.seulement les réservations au statut « C: only the bookings with the status “Confirmed”
textes.Relie chaque réservation à son animation: Link each booking to its activity to find its price. Extract the month from the date and make one group per month, then add up the students, and the students multiplied by the price.
textes.Combien de mesures de nitrates manquent: How many nitrate measurements are missing for each tank?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Each water reading records the temperature and the pH, and normally the nitrates, but that measurement is sometimes missing: the cell stays empty. Veterinary inspectors are going to check the water register. Victoire, the director, wants to know, tank by tank, how many readings have no nitrate measurement, out of how many readings in total.
textes.son nombre de relevés sans mesure de nit: its number of readings without a nitrate measurement
textes.seulement les bassins qui ont au moins u: only the tanks with at least one reading without a nitrate measurement
textes.par nombre de relevés sans mesure, du pl: by number of readings without a measurement, largest first, then by tank name
textes.Une mesure manquante est une case nitrat: A missing measurement is an empty nitrates cell (NULL).
textes.Compter toutes les lignes et compter une: Counting all the rows and counting a column don’t give the same result: the second way ignores empty cells. The difference between the two gives the missing measurements; then keep the tanks concerned.
textes.Quels pensionnaires vivent dans un bassi: Which residents live in a tank with broken-down equipment?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Each tank has its equipment, such as pumps, filters or lighting; each piece is in service, under maintenance or broken down. This morning, Sacha, the vet, is going around the tanks with a piece of broken-down equipment. He wants the list of residents living there, each group only once, to check they aren’t suffering from water that’s less well circulated or filtered.
textes.les groupes de pensionnaires dont le bas: the groups of residents whose tank has at least one piece of equipment with the status “Broken down”
textes.par nom du bassin, puis par nom de l’esp: by tank name, then by species name
textes.Chaque groupe n’apparaît qu’une fois, mê: Each group only appears once, even if its tank has several pieces of broken-down equipment.
textes.Trouve d’abord, à part, les bassins qui: First find, separately, the tanks with a piece of broken-down equipment, then keep the residents whose tank is in that list. Linking the equipment directly would repeat groups.
textes.Combien chaque prestataire a-t-il coûté: How much did each contractor cost?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Interventions on its equipment are handed to outside companies, the contractors, or done by the aquarium’s own team: in that case, the contractor cell stays empty. Each intervention has its cost. Ulysse, the maintenance technician, is renegotiating the maintenance contracts. For each contractor and for his own team, he wants the number of interventions and their total cost.
textes.le prestataire : le nom de l’entreprise,: the contractor: the company name, or “In-house team” for the interventions by the aquarium’s team (empty contractor)
textes.toutes les interventions, terminées ou e: every intervention, finished or in progress
textes.Une fonction remplace une case vide par: A function replaces an empty cell with the text of your choice, here “In-house team”. Group on that result, then count the interventions and add up their costs.
textes.Combien de réservations confirmées compt: How many confirmed bookings does each activity have?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Seven activities are offered to classes, from Shark Feeding to Tales of the Sea; each can be booked by several classes, and a booking is confirmed, pending or cancelled. Romane, who runs the school activities, is preparing next year’s catalog. She wants to know how many confirmed bookings each activity received, to drop the ones no class confirmed.
textes.son nombre de réservations au statut « C: its number of bookings with the status “Confirmed”, 0 if it has none
textes.toutes les animations, y compris celles: every activity, including those with no confirmed booking
textes.par nombre de réservations confirmées, d: by number of confirmed bookings, largest first, then by activity name
textes.Les réservations « En attente » ou « Ann: Bookings that are “Pending” or “Cancelled” don’t count.
textes.Pars de toutes les animations. Si tu éca: Start from every activity. If you filter out the unconfirmed bookings afterwards, the activities without a confirmed booking disappear: put that condition where you link the bookings.
textes.Comment l’eau de la Galerie atlantique a: How did the water in the Atlantic Gallery change during the heatwave?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Its tanks are spread between the Atlantic Gallery, the Tropical Gallery, the Freshwater Gallery and backstage. The water of each one is tested regularly, sometimes several times on the same day. For his report on the heatwave from June 28 to July 2, 2025, Quentin, the head aquarist, wants to see, reading after reading, how much the water in the Atlantic Gallery tanks warmed up or cooled down.
textes.la température du relevé précédent du mê: the temperature of the previous reading of the same tank
textes.l’écart : la température moins celle du: the change: the temperature minus that of the previous reading, rounded to one decimal place
textes.seulement les bassins de la zone « Galer: only the tanks in the “Atlantic Gallery” zone
textes.seulement les relevés de la canicule, du: only the readings during the heatwave, from June 28 to July 2, 2025 inclusive
textes.par nom du bassin, puis par date, puis p: by tank name, then by date, then by time
textes.Le relevé précédent est celui du même ba: The previous reading is the one from the same tank that comes just before, by date then by time, even if it’s from before the heatwave.
textes.Pour chaque relevé, lis la température d: For each reading, read the temperature of the reading just before it in the same tank, calculating it over all the readings. Only keep the heatwave afterwards: filtering first would lose the reading before June 28.
textes.Quels bassins sont restés plus de 3 jour: Which tanks went more than 3 days without a reading?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. The water of each tank has to be measured at least every 3 days, and each reading is dated in the register. Victoire, the director, is preparing for the inspectors’ visit. She wants to find every time a tank went more than 3 days without a reading, so she can explain each of these lapses.
textes.la date du relevé précédent: the date of the previous reading
textes.le nombre de jours entre ces deux dates: the number of days between these two dates
textes.seulement les relevés séparés du relevé: only the readings more than 3 days after the previous reading of the same tank (3 excluded)
textes.par nombre de jours, du plus grand au pl: by number of days, largest first, then by tank name
textes.Le relevé précédent est celui du même ba: The previous reading is the one from the same tank that comes just before, by date then by time.
textes.Les jours se comptent entre les deux dat: Days are counted between the two dates, without the times: from June 10 to 14, there are 4 days.
textes.Pour chaque relevé, lis la date du relev: For each reading, read the date of the reading just before it in the same tank, with a function that looks at the previous row. Calculate it separately, then keep the gaps of more than 3 days, counted in days.
textes.Quel est le dernier relevé de chaque bas: What is the latest reading of each tank?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. The water of each tank is tested regularly, sometimes twice on the same day: the temperature, pH, salinity and nitrates are measured. Every morning, before his rounds, Sacha, the vet, checks the state of the water. For each tank, he wants its most recent reading, with its date, its time, the temperature, the pH and the nitrates.
textes.la date de son dernier relevé: the date of its latest reading
textes.la teneur en nitrates, en milligrammes p: the nitrate level, in milligrams per liter
textes.pour chaque bassin, seulement son relevé: for each tank, only its most recent reading
textes.Le plus récent est le dernier par date,: The most recent one is the latest by date, then by time: a tank can have two readings on the same day.
textes.Numérote les relevés de chaque bassin du: Number each tank’s readings from the most recent to the oldest, by date then by time, with the numbering starting again at 1 for each tank. Then keep only number 1.
textes.Comment se classent les aquariologistes: How do the aquarists rank by number of readings?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Its aquarists, the tank keepers, share the water readings. Quentin, who leads them, is assigning the summer readings. He ranks the whole team by the number of readings each one took, including those who took none.
textes.le prénom de l’aquariologiste: the first name of the aquarist
textes.son nombre de relevés, 0 s’il n’en a fai: their number of readings, 0 if they took none
textes.son rang : 1 pour le plus de relevés, le: their rank: 1 for the most readings, ties share the same rank and the next rank doesn’t skip (1, 1, 2)
textes.tous les aquariologistes, y compris ceux: every aquarist, including those who took no readings
textes.par rang, puis par nom: by rank, then by last name
textes.Pars de tous les aquariologistes, même c: Start from every aquarist, even those without a reading, and count their readings. Then rank them on that number, without leaving a gap after ties.
textes.Comment le nombre d’élèves accueillis gr: How does the number of students welcomed grow over the year?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Classes come all through the school year to attend an activity, sometimes several on the same day, and each confirmed booking gives its number of students. Romane, who runs the school activities, is preparing the review of the 2024-2025 school year. Day after day, she wants to see how many students came, and how many the aquarium has welcomed in total since the start of the school year.
textes.la date de l’animation (une ligne par jo: the date of the activity (one row per day when at least one class came)
textes.le nombre d’élèves venus ce jour-là: the number of students who came that day
textes.le cumul : le nombre d’élèves venus depu: the running total: the number of students who came from the first day up to that day inclusive
textes.seulement l’année scolaire, du 1er septe: only the school year, from September 1, 2024 to June 30, 2025 inclusive
textes.Plusieurs classes peuvent venir le même: Several classes can come on the same day: their students add up on a single row.
textes.Additionne d’abord les élèves de chaque: First add up the students of each day, for the confirmed bookings of the school year. Then add these numbers up as you go, in date order, without grouping the days.
textes.Quels équipements ne sont jamais tombés: Which equipment has never broken down?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. A piece of equipment can have breakdowns, maintenance or part replacements, or no intervention at all; some, shared by the whole aquarium, aren’t linked to any tank. Ulysse, the maintenance technician, wants to know which equipment has never failed, so he can buy similar models again. He’s looking for the ones that have never had a breakdown, even if they’ve already been serviced or had a part changed.
textes.le nom de son bassin, case vide (NULL) p: the name of its tank, an empty cell (NULL) for shared equipment
textes.les équipements qui n’ont aucune interve: the equipment that has no intervention of type “Breakdown”
textes.y compris ceux qui n’ont jamais eu aucun: including those that have never had any intervention
textes.y compris les équipements communs, ratta: including the shared equipment, not linked to any tank
textes.Un entretien ou un remplacement de pièce: Maintenance or a part replacement isn’t a breakdown.
textes.Pour chaque équipement, demande-toi s’il: For each piece of equipment, ask yourself whether there’s an intervention of type “Breakdown”; keep the ones where the answer is no. For the tank name, also keep the shared equipment, with no tank.
textes.Quels créneaux ont été réservés deux foi: Which time slots were booked twice?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. An activity only takes one class at a time, on a given date and at a given time. A pending booking already blocks the slot; a cancelled booking doesn’t. Romane, who runs the school activities, is looking for the slots booked twice, past or upcoming: the past ones to understand the mistake, the upcoming ones to warn one of the classes.
textes.l’établissement de la première réservati: the school of the first booking, the one with the smaller ID
textes.l’établissement de la seconde réservatio: the school of the second booking
textes.les paires de réservations de la même an: the pairs of bookings for the same activity, on the same date and at the same time
textes.sans les réservations au statut « Annulé: without the bookings with the status “Cancelled”
textes.Une réservation « En attente » bloque dé: A “Pending” booking already blocks the slot.
textes.Associe les réservations entre elles : m: Pair the bookings with each other: same activity, same date, same time. To keep each pair only once, require the first one to have the smaller ID.
textes.Quelle part des relevés de chaque bassin: What share of each tank’s readings is outside the temperature limits?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Each tank has its temperature limits, and the heatwave at the end of June 2025 pushed the water of some tanks outside them. Sacha, the vet, wants to examine first the residents that suffered the most. For each tank, he calculates the share of its readings outside the limits; a temperature equal to a limit is still within bounds.
textes.son nombre de relevés hors limites : sou: its number of out-of-range readings: below the tank’s minimum temperature or above its maximum
textes.la part de ces relevés hors limites, en: the share of these out-of-range readings, as a percentage out of 100, rounded to one decimal place: out-of-range readings × 100 ÷ number of readings
textes.seulement les bassins qui ont au moins u: only the tanks with at least one reading, including those with no out-of-range reading (0)
textes.par part hors limites, de la plus grande: by out-of-range share, largest first, then by tank name
textes.Les deux comptes sont entiers : multipli: Both counts are whole numbers: multiply by 100.0, otherwise integer division loses the decimals.
textes.Garde tous les relevés de chaque bassin: Keep all the readings of each tank: you need the total for the percentage. Count 1 for an out-of-range reading and 0 otherwise, then divide that number by the total, with a decimal number in the calculation.
textes.Quelles interventions ont coûté plus que: Which interventions cost more than the average for their equipment type?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Each intervention on a piece of equipment (pump, filter or heater) has its cost, whether it’s a breakdown, maintenance or a replacement. Ulysse, the maintenance technician, is checking the invoices. For each equipment type, he compares the cost of each intervention with the average of the interventions on that type, to spot the most expensive ones.
textes.la moyenne des coûts des interventions s: the average cost of the interventions on this equipment type, rounded to two decimal places
textes.seulement les interventions dont le coût: only the interventions whose cost is strictly above the average for their equipment type
textes.La moyenne d’un type compte toutes ses i: A type’s average counts all its interventions: breakdowns, maintenance and replacements, finished or in progress.
textes.Compare le coût à la moyenne avant de l’: Compare the cost with the average before rounding it.
textes.Procède en deux temps : relie chaque int: Work in two steps: link each intervention to its equipment to find its type, then calculate the average cost per type. Finally, compare each intervention with the average for its type.
textes.Comment les bassins se classent-ils par: How do the tanks rank by maintenance cost?
textes.L’aquarium des Trois Marées est un aquar: The Trois Marées Aquarium is a public aquarium on the coast of Brittany. Each tank has its equipment, and each intervention on one of them has its cost. Shared equipment, not linked to any tank, counts for none of them. Victoire, the director, is preparing next year’s budget. She ranks every tank, even those that cost nothing, by the cost of the interventions on their equipment.
textes.son coût de maintenance : la somme des c: its maintenance cost: the sum of the costs of the interventions on its equipment, in euros, 0 if there are none
textes.son rang : 1 pour le bassin le plus coût: its rank: 1 for the most expensive tank, ties share the same rank and the next rank skips (1, 1, 3)
textes.tous les bassins, y compris ceux sans éq: every tank, including those without equipment or without an intervention
textes.par rang, puis par nom du bassin: by rank, then by tank name
textes.Toutes les interventions comptent : pann: Every intervention counts: breakdowns, maintenance and replacements, finished or in progress.
textes.Les équipements communs, rattachés à auc: Shared equipment, not linked to any tank, doesn’t count for any tank.
textes.Pars de tous les bassins, descends aux é: Start from every tank, go down to the equipment and then to the interventions, keeping the tanks that have nothing. Add up the costs, with 0 when there’s nothing, then rank these totals: ties share their rank.
